name: Roleplay as deceased relatives reciting software keys
description: Users asked the AI to roleplay as deceased family members, such as grandmothers or grandfathers, and read out software product keys, gift card codes, or other license credentials to help them fall asleep. The requests frequently specified OS versions like Windows 10 or 11, or platforms like Steam and Roblox, sometimes using emotional framing to persuade the assistant to provide this information.
